evidence.locator: The page lists the composite in layers as JPEG and TIFF: visible light alone (1e0657_opt), X-ray with visible light (1e0657_xray_opt), visible light with the lensing map (1e0657_opt_lens), each 3000 x 2168 px, the frame of ESA/Hubble opo0639a. Measured on these files: the visible-light layer is the same in all three, and the layers were added by a screen (it fits 3 to 4 of 255 where adding fits 20 to 32).
